name: bridgistic-claude-marketplace
description: Free public distribution of Bridgistic: Claude Code marketplace, Claude Desktop setup package, WordPress plugin, and local MCP server for safely connecting Claude to WordPress.

scripts.bootstrap: cd mcp-server && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && cd ../cloud && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.build: npm --prefix mcp-server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix mcp-server run build && npm --prefix mcp-server run bundle
scripts.build:ci: npm --prefix mcp-server run build && npm --prefix mcp-server run bundle
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:php && npm run test:cloud && npm run test:bundle

author: WordPressistic
